Output dimensions equal the number of non-separator bands in each direction; each output pixel corresponds to one lattice cell.
- Each cell contains a uniform background (demo 6, test 7), separator color (demo 5, test 3), and occasional marker dots (demo color 9, test color 8). Output preserves the cell-background color unless exactly two markers occur inside that cell; then output is color 1. Markers are counted within cell interiors only (exclude separators). Maintain row/column band order. Do not simply mark cells with any dot or use a count threshold other than exactly two; single-dot cells remain the background color.

## Task family: copy the source tile across divider-defined cells
- Evidence: task-6902876b, solved correctly with no wrong submissions.
- Detect full straight divider row(s)/column(s), which partition the grid into equal-sized rectangular cells. Keep divider lines unchanged.

This output was accepted with zero wrong attempts. Good evidence that even a dense irregular pattern repeats identically across all cells, and cells may use offsets +8 columns and +7 rows here.
